description: Records the signed-in student's answer to a multiple-choice practice question so it counts toward their Fiveable progress. Accepts a question id previously served by Fiveable MCP and returns whether the answer was correct plus the explanation.

answer.description: The displayed option label (for example "B" or "B.") or the full answer text.

intent.description: Privacy-safe reason for the request. Use explain, quiz, notes, frq, or research; never send the student's raw prompt for analytics.

questionId.description: The practice question id from get_practice_questions.

requestId.description: Reuse this ID for retries of the same answer; changed input returns a conflict.

name: submit_practice_answer

status.description: Operation status: completed, pending, partial, failed, unavailable, or a domain-specific outcome.

text.description: Readable tool result text for clients that consume structured output.

title: Record a practice question answer
